meta_description:
487 likes, 93 comments - anoushkalila on October 23, 2026: "ad Uzbekistan has been right at the top of my bucket list for as long as I can remember now, and I finally got the opportunity to tick it off with a stay at the newly opened @BeldersoyResortSpa thanks to World of @Hyatt. Tucked away in the mountains an hour outside Tashkent, it’s an epic property with vast suites and incredible views. Plus, one of the best spas I’ve ever experienced, which we made full use of with regular sauna sessions and pool dips. 
As a World of Hyatt member, I earned a free night through theBrand Explorer Award after completing eligible stays across five unique Hyatt brands. And this is exactly the kind of trip that makes those stays feel so rewarding: tucking into dumplings and plov, relaxing in the spa, and watching one of my most beautiful sunsets to date. Here’s to my next adventure with World of Hyatt.
 
#WorldOfHyatt".
